title: Token-2022 extension set
detects: Token-2022 mints can carry extensions including transfer fees, transfer hooks, permanent delegate and non-transferable. Permanent delegate in particular grants an address perpetual authority over every holder's balance.
knownFalseNegative: A mint owned by the legacy Token program can never carry extensions, so this must only be evaluated when the account owner is the Token-2022 program. Verified on 2026-07-22: all 8 seeded Solana tokens use the legacy Token program, so none are affected. Any new token using Token-2022 must be checked here, and permanent delegate is the most severe capability in the SPL ecosystem.

coversExamples.observed: owned by legacy Token program TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA, extensions not applicable

rationale: Token-2022 adoption is rising and its extensions grant powers with no equivalent in the legacy program. Absent this pattern, a permanent delegate is completely invisible.
